future_retrieval_rules: A later authorized job may follow a catalog URL only when network access and the source's access terms permit it.
Never bypass authentication, payment, regional controls, robots restrictions, or other access controls; never copy secrets, hidden grader data, sealed references, or another learner's work.
Record the requested URL, resolved URL, retrieval time, content type, license or usage basis, byte hash, and retrieval result for every acquired artifact.
Keep failed, denied, missing, and ambiguous retrievals blocked with evidence instead of guessing their contents.
Inspect and classify acquired content before creating graph units; a normalized record or an official flag alone does not establish unit boundaries, dependencies, or completion requirements.
Preserve distinct catalog roles that share a URL until inspection establishes whether they refer to the same content.
Place only explicitly learner-safe material in learner-visible locations and keep examiner assets separate.
retrieval_policy.future_unit_expansion_gate: Content must be locally available with provenance, an explicit validation label, learner-visibility classification, and an independently justified unit boundary before it may become a required unit.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If retrieval remains unavailable, author another clearly labeled, self-contained manager unit or leave expansion pending; do not present reconstructed material as official.

provenance.classification: availability assessment from supplied catalog snapshot and local workspace inspection
